title: 金屬薄箔超音波增材製造
titleEn: Ultrasonic Additive Manufacturing of Metal Foils
summary: 「金屬薄箔超音波增材製造」教學路線圖：固態薄箔接合、層間品質、嵌入式元件與尺寸量測。專案級來源與工序細節待查證。
summaryEn: Learning roadmap for Ultrasonic Additive Manufacturing of Metal Foils: solid state foil bonding, interlayer quality, embedded components, and dimensional metrology. Project-specific sources and work steps require verification.
